environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with no origin access restrictions. The ALB forwards all HTTP traffic directly to port 8080. No CDN layer. Security groups allow inbound 80/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF rules attached. Redis is co-located on the same instance.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules, no WAF
config.origin_access: Direct HTTP access to application, no signed URL requirement
config.redis: Local Redis 6.2 on localhost:6379, no AUTH
